entries: {DISASTER:strikes} knocked out the cameras in {place}, and {first} noticed the gap
{first} found {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING} and read what it opened: the {rival}'s vault
an envelope from {SOMEONE:human,!plural} named one night, one target, and {landmark}
the {rival} cheated {SOMEONE:human,!plural} out of everything, and {first} was asked to even the score
{SOMEONE:!plural} sat down with {first} {MANNER} and slid {THING:valuable} across the table
{SOMEONE:human,!plural} passed {first} {THING:portable} at {landmark} {MANNER}, and said nothing more
{first} watched {SOMEONE:human,!plural} work {landmark} {MANNER} and spotted what everyone missed
{DISASTER:strikes} cleared out {landmark}, and the door stood open for {first} {MANNER}
the {rival} cornered {first} {MANNER}, and a job was the exit
